<ApiTitle method="post" title="Cancel Bulk Batch" />

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/turbosign/bulk/batch/{batchId}/cancel"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Stops a pending or processing batch: jobs not yet sent are cancelled and their credits are refunded, while documents already sent are not affected. Cancelling cannot be undone.
